sourceRole: supplementary primary scientific authoring witnesses, not curriculum coverage or independent review

sources.verifiedAuthoringPoint: Official aerobic biodegradation methods distinguish DOC/CO2/oxygen endpoints and require inoculum blanks/reference checks. Candidate numbers remain supplied teaching models and are not regulatory thresholds.

University redox assay: oxidized DCPIP is red in acidic solution and reduced reagent is colorless; endpoint visibility has matrix limitations. Candidate controls pH and makes no concentration claim from a qualitative test.

University iodine/starch redox protocol supports one mole iodine per mole ascorbic acid. Candidate writes balanced half-reactions, retains model notation I2, and does not claim unique substance identification from reduction alone.
Original educational assay supports blue-to-colorless DCPIP reduction and explicitly notes pink/magenta under acidic conditions. Candidate neutral model and pH controls preserve that distinction.
